Interface Fabric1211ProcessRunner

All Known Implementing Classes:

Functional Interface:
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
@FunctionalInterface public interface Fabric1211ProcessRunner
External Gradle/Minecraft process boundary for Fabric workspace tasks.

    • wrapperCommand

      static List<String> wrapperCommand(boolean windows, String configuredGradle, boolean launcherExecutable)
      The workspace wrapper is addressed relative to the process directory. A bare gradlew.bat relies on cmd's current-directory search, which NoDefaultCurrentDirectoryInExePath disables.

    • daemonArguments

      static List<String> daemonArguments(List<String> arguments, boolean reuseDaemon)
      Builds, GameTests, datagen and exports reuse a warm daemon. A single-use daemon repeats JVM start, plugin loading and Loom configuration for every task: a one-line Fabric 1.21.1 edit built in about 27 seconds that way and in about 8 seconds on a warm daemon. Client and server runs stay single-use so the game remains a descendant of the wrapper process that a stop request terminates. A workspace's own org.gradle.daemon=false still applies, because no --daemon flag is passed.
